title: Deewanae Hyder
body:
ali ali ali ali ali ali ya ali
asadullah yadullah saifullah wajhullah
ainullah noorullah jumbullah baabullah
<<DIVIDER>>
deewana e hyder hoo mai mastaan e hyder hoo
parwana e hyder hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
ishqe hyder hai sukoon ishqe hyder hai junoon
kaam kuch aur nahi bas yehi kehta phirun
ye ibadat hai meri ye hai tasbeeh meri
ali ali ali ali...
deewana e hyder hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri fitrat mein yehi hai ke mai haq bolta hoo
apne maula ke fazayil mein gohar tol ta hoo
jaa ke mimbar pe mai israar e khafi kholta hoo
farsh se arsh talak jaante hai ye malak
toor pe noor tha wo mere maula ki jhalak
hoor o haiwan ne kaha dekh kar noore jali
ali ali ali ali...
deewana e hyder hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ko haq hai ke mujhe saahib e kirdar kaho
mujhko hyder ke ghulamon ka bhi hubdaar kaho
khuld jis par hui waajib wohi maykhaar kaho
ay zamane ye bata mai kahan jaaun bhala
chahiye mujhko faqad ishqe hyder ka nasha
aisa maikhana dikha jiska saaqi ho ali
ali ali ali ali...
deewana e hyder hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai to darwaishon ki basti ko hi pehchanta hoo
jo malangane ali hai mai unhe jaanta hoo
maanta hai jo ali ko mai unhe maanta hoo
hai mera naam o nasab mere maula ke sabab
jo hai waliyon ka wali shaahe deen shaahe arab
misle kaaba hai ye dil aur dhadkan mein meri
ali ali ali ali...
deewana e hyder hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab talak jaan mein hai jaan gawahi doonga
mera maula mera emaan gawahi doonga
hai wohi bolta quran gawahi doonga
meri bakshish ka hai saaman gawahi doonga
ali ali ali ali...
deewana e hyder hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi iski mohabbat mein guzar jaaye to kya
ishq ban kar wo mere dil mein utar jaaye to kya
rooh phir jism se parwaaz bhi kar jaaye to kya
muqtasar baat karun pesh jazbaat karun
qabr mein aaye ali mai mulaqaat karun
phir ali se hi kahun tha mera wird yehi
ali ali ali ali...
deewana e hyder hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
saahib e loh o qalam unke siwa koi nahi
haamil e taygh o alam unke siwa koi nahi
maalik e mulk e adam unke siwa koi nahi
jis taraf jaaye nazar bas wohi aaye nazar
unka deedar ho jab phir sukoon paaye nazar
ishq dikhlaye mujhe sirf aur sirf wohi
ali ali ali ali...
deewana e hyder hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ghadi safdar o mazhar ka hai damsaaz ali
deta rehta hai takhayyul ko bhi parwaaz ali
yani lafzon ko ataa karta hai awaaz ali
hai sakhawat ka hasham yani awaaz o qalam
is waseele se kare apni har baat ko hum
yak zaban ho ke kahe dono maulayi yehi
ali ali ali ali...
deewana e hyder hoo...
author: Mazhar Abidi
